name: Ichikawa Fumiyasu
source:
The protagonist of the "Schrödinger's Hand" scenario. A TV scriptwriter. 38 years old. As a writer, he works under the pen name "Tetsuo Nakashima" and does not use his real name unless he feels very confident in his work. At the age of 28, he won a literary newcomer's award and started making a living as a writer. A few years ago, he worked on a TV drama that became a huge hit, which made him famous in the industry, and he has been writing plots for various TV dramas ever since.
Although he wants to write high-quality stories, he is disgusted by the reality that there is a demand for low-quality dramas and that he is involved in most of them. He also feels uneasy when strangers submit their own works pretending to be him.
He suffers from neurosis caused by stress, and frequently takes sleeping pills to escape reality, and has such a stoic way of thinking that he finds value in them. He also uses alcohol (he prefers straight bourbon) and caffeine pills.
Although he has his own home, he lives at the Nanbu Hotel in Shibuya. As the hotel does all the house cleaning, he rarely goes home.
His hobby is watching movies (recently he mostly watches them for work reference). His special skill is drawing. He is a Capricorn.

[From [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/街_〜運命の交差点〜]Wikipedia[/url]]
